title: The rest of the Moody band and clarinetist Kid Ernest
summary: Band members including Moody's sons and a bassist from Delacroix, and the clarinetist known as Kid Ernest, whose style was unlike anyone's.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
